name: V-Mart Retail Ltd
title: V-Mart Retail Ltd - 534976 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: V-Mart Q1 FY27 revenue rose 23% YoY with 9% like-for-like growth, while PAT grew 41% to INR 47 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue grew 23% YoY with same-store sales up 9% (V-Mart 8%, Unlimited 13%), marking the 11th consecutive quarter of positive LFL growth. Pre-Ind AS EBITDA rose 36% to INR 83 crore (margin 7.6%) and PAT rose 41% to INR 47 crore. Gross margin fell 80 bps to 34.5% on mix change and aged-inventory provisioning, partly offset by 150 bps of operating leverage as expenses rose 15%. Management flagged raw material inflation of around 10%, rising minimum wages, and a weaker Q2 due to Durga Puja shifting into Q3.

financial_highlights.value: Down 39% YoY and 7% QoQ on 18% higher NMV

segments.name: V-Mart (core)
segments.commentary: SSG 8% in the quarter; apparel ASP up 2%; memo count up 18% YoY; footfalls up 39%.

segments.name: Unlimited (South India)
segments.commentary: Revenue up 33%, EBITDA up 40%; sales per sq ft INR 710, up 18% YoY; SSG 13%. Newer stores are outperforming acquired legacy stores on SPSF.

segments.name: LimeRoad (marketplace)
segments.commentary: Losses down 39% YoY and 7% QoQ despite 18% higher NMV; first quarter in eight with NMV growth and falling EBITDA loss.

guidance_outlook: Store expansion guidance for FY27 unchanged at 90+ gross openings; management expects 8-10 closures this year.
Management targets mid-to-high single-digit SSG for the year, per Q&A.
Price increase range of 3-5% ASP targeted; about 2-2.5% overall price increase expected from inflation, with mix change also contributing.
Management expects 0.5-0.75% of margin compromise to absorb raw material inflation; margin loss to stay below 1%.
Q2 FY27 expected to see negative impact on sales and margins from Durga Puja shifting into Q3 (19-day shift); recovery expected in Q3 festive season.
Expects Unlimited and V-Mart store-level EBITDA margins to converge over time; more Southern store openings than last year.
Employee cost to be held flat as a percentage of sales despite minimum wage hikes.
capex_capacity: Q1 capex INR 38 crore, mainly new store additions and selective refurbishments.
Added 15 stores and closed 1 in Q1; network at 591 stores across 335 cities, total 51 lakh sq ft.
FY27 expansion guidance 90+ stores, with more Unlimited openings in South India than last year.
Operating cash flow of INR 76 crore in the quarter; balance sheet debt-free with zero long-term debt and bank limit utilisation near nil.
demand_pricing: Footfalls up 39% and memo count up 18% YoY; conversion fell from mid-40s to 38-39%, attributed to heavier competition and some past counting errors.
Apparel ASP up 2% YoY, driven by product-line mix (sets and combos) rather than inflation.
Days of inventory down 8% YoY to 86 days; inventory per store down 5% to around INR 1.5 crore.
Raw material costs up around 10%, linked to crude, cotton, and yarn; partial pass-through to customers so far, with caution on demand elasticity.
Monsoon rainfall about 30% deficient as of call date, with partial recovery in late July; watchful on rural demand.
Karnataka minimum wage hike on stay; vendor exposure to Karnataka below 5% per management.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the 80 bps gross margin decline and how is the split between mix change and provisioning?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the split is not equal and varies over time. Mix change reflects customer preference, not deliberate changes. Provisioning follows a 10-15 year old policy applied every quarter. Benefits should come as aged inventory is liquidated.

qa_highlights.question: Why has conversion dropped from mid-40s to 38-39%?
qa_highlights.answer: Partly past counting errors and partly greater competition, with customers shopping across stores and returning later. Memo count still grew 18%.

qa_highlights.question: How will raw material inflation be passed on?
qa_highlights.answer: Around 10% RM inflation; some passed on, some offset through vendor efficiencies and yarn mix changes. Margin compromise limited to 0.5-0.75%. Price increase target 3-5% ASP including mix.

qa_highlights.question: How much minimum wage impact is in Q1 and what remains?
qa_highlights.answer: Two of three months of the wage hike are already in Q1 wage bill. Further increases are coming. Karnataka is on stay, with no provision made.

qa_highlights.question: What is the SSG expectation for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Mid-to-high single digit SSG, aiming to beat last year's SSG.

qa_highlights.question: What SSG is needed for operating leverage to continue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 3-4% SSG offsets inflation, since about 95-98% of costs are fixed except marketing.

qa_highlights.question: Will Unlimited store additions accelerate and will margins converge?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, more Southern openings than last year. Gross margin in Unlimited is structurally higher; EBITDA margin gap narrowing as legacy stores improve, with similar margins expected over time.

risks_watch: Raw material inflation (crude-linked yarn, cotton, dyes) and supply-chain stability for festive season deliveries.
Gross margin pressure from provisioning and mix; management expects benefits only in later quarters.
Conversion trend below mid-40s amid rising competition.
Minimum wage hikes in UP and Karnataka; Karnataka impact not yet provided for.
Monsoon deficiency affecting rural demand; Q2 weaker on Durga Puja timing shift.
summary.management_tone: Confident on top-line growth, Unlimited and LimeRoad losses, but cautious on raw material costs, monsoon and consumer price sensitivity. Management repeatedly stressed disciplined expansion and not chasing headline growth.
key_quotes: The objective is not simply to increase the gross margin, but our objective is to improve the rupee gross margin, absolute profitability, better throughput, faster fashion, and healthier sell-through.
We are seeing maybe around 10% rise in the overall raw material prices, out of which some prices are being passed on.
As of now it has not been implemented. It is on stay.

adds.what: 90+ gross store openings in FY27 (V-Mart and Unlimited, more Unlimited/Southern openings than last year)

growth.why: FY27 guidance of 90+ gross store openings held unchanged and mid-to-high single-digit SSG targeted, with Q1 revenue +23% and SSG +9%; backing is store pipeline plus ASP/mix, but no order-style visibility and SSG guidance is qualitative per Q&A.
